strings.ui.options.audio.help: Music, effects, voice and movie volumes.
strings.ui.options.auto_load.help: Load the last save after Game Over.
strings.ui.options.auto_reload.help: Reloads an empty gun by itself. Original: also while aiming.
strings.ui.options.aim_resume_after_inventory.he: Aim comes straight back up after the inventory. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.bullet_decals.help: Leave marks on walls and floors.
strings.ui.options.control_2d.help: Harry walks where the stick points on screen.
strings.ui.options.controls.help: Key bindings, vibration, mouse and stick.
strings.ui.options.cutscene_line_gap_ms.help: Silence between spoken lines in cutscenes.
strings.ui.options.debug_options.help: Debug tools in the pause menu and on F10.
strings.ui.options.modding_tools.help: F2 opens the map editor and viewer for modders.
strings.ui.options.disable_dpad_movement.help: Frees the D-pad for other actions.
strings.ui.options.display.help: Aspect ratio, resolution, display mode, brightness.
strings.ui.options.flashlight_style.help: Classic: the original beam, no shadows. Modern: soft beam.
strings.ui.options.fog_strength.help: How thick the town's fog is.
strings.ui.options.ambient_occlusion.help: Soft shadow in corners and under objects, from the map's own light only.
strings.ui.options.volumetric_fog.help: The flashlight beam shows in the fog; the fog itself stays as thick as the original.
strings.ui.options.fog_scatter.help: How much of the beam the fog scatters.
strings.ui.options.god_rays.help: The sun shows in the fog as shafts through trees, fences and windows; the fog stays as thick as the original.
strings.ui.options.map_lights.help: Lamps, the match and the overcast sun light the scene without ray tracing; the original light stays the floor.
strings.ui.options.sun_shadows.help: The sun casts soft shadows up to where the fog ends; fences and leaves let light through.
strings.ui.options.particle_shadows.help: Falling snow and ash cast small soft shadows of the flashlight and the sun.
strings.ui.options.extra_lights.help: Lamps placed by hand where rooms show lit fixtures; they follow the story (power on or off). The fog and the darkness stay. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.atmosphere.unsupported: Your graphics card cannot run this.
strings.ui.options.upscaler.help: TAA smooths edges over several frames; TAAU and Spatial draw the world smaller and scale it up to the screen.
strings.ui.options.upscale_quality.help: How small the world is drawn: Quality 67 %, Balanced 58 %, Performance 50 %, Ultra Performance 33 %.
strings.ui.options.upscale_sharpness.help: Sharpens the result without halos round the fog and the beam.
strings.ui.options.present_mode.help: Auto follows V-Sync. FIFO waits for the display, Mailbox shows the newest frame without tearing, Immediate may tear, FIFO Relaxed tears only when late.
strings.ui.options.frames_in_flight.help: Frames the CPU may prepare ahead of the GPU: 1 lowers the delay, 2 keeps the frame rate steadier.
strings.ui.options.present_wait.help: Waits until the frame before is on screen before the next one starts.
strings.ui.options.present_wait.unsupported: Unavailable: the driver cannot report when a frame is on screen.
strings.ui.options.fps_fov.help: Field of view in first person.
strings.ui.options.gameplay.help: Auto load, reload, quick save, extra options.
strings.ui.options.graphics_preset.help: Sets the picture options. Some need a restart.
strings.ui.options.invert_controller_y.help: Look up and down the other way.
strings.ui.options.invert_mouse_y.help: Look up and down the other way.
strings.ui.options.keybinds.help: Change keyboard, mouse and pad buttons.
strings.ui.options.language.help: Language of the text and the menus.
strings.ui.options.skip_intros.help: Skips the warning, the logos and the opening movie: starts at the main menu.
strings.ui.options.lighting.help: Flashlight style, its shadows and beam; the light on Harry.
strings.ui.options.lighting_style.help: Classic: the original. Modern: soft, smooth light.
strings.ui.options.low_health_glow.help: Screen glow when Harry is badly hurt.
strings.ui.options.msaa.help: Smooths jagged polygon edges. Higher costs more.
strings.ui.options.ots_fov.help: Field of view over the shoulder.
strings.ui.options.post_process.help: A full-screen look: CRT, film grain and more.
strings.ui.options.quick_weapon_switch.help: Number keys and the wheel change weapons.
strings.ui.options.reset_defaults.help: All settings to defaults; resolution kept.
strings.ui.options.resolution.help: Window size in pixels. Follows a window resized by hand.
strings.ui.options.shadow_quality.help: Shadows cast by the modern flashlight.
strings.ui.options.texture_filter.help: Smooths textures; higher is sharper at angles.
strings.ui.options.title: OPTIONS
strings.ui.options.tps_fov.help: Field of view in third person.
strings.ui.options.tps_ots_aim.help: Aiming moves the camera over the shoulder.
strings.ui.options.tps_camera_smoothing.help: How softly the camera follows Harry. 0% is rigid.
strings.ui.options.tps_look_smoothing.help: Smooths camera turns with the mouse and right stick. 0% is raw.
strings.ui.options.tps_camera_recenter.help: While Harry moves and you are not looking around, the camera levels out behind him.
strings.ui.options.tps_camera_collision.help: Keeps the camera out of walls.
strings.ui.options.use_pgxp.help: Removes the original console's wobbling polygons.
strings.ui.options.walk_run_control.help: Run by default or on the button.
strings.ui.options.weapon_control.help: Hold or press to ready a weapon.
strings.ui.options.widescreen_mode.help: Bars, wider view or stretched picture.
strings.ui.options.camera.help: Alternative cameras (F9): field of view, aiming, crosshair.
strings.ui.options.control_style.help: The original fixed camera or a free one (F9 switches).
strings.ui.options.crosshair_fps_aim_only.help: The crosshair shows only while aiming.
strings.ui.options.crosshair_hide_melee.help: No crosshair unless a gun is equipped.
strings.ui.options.load_screen_trail.help: Harry's afterimage on the loading screen.
strings.ui.options.model_upscaling.help: Experimental. Rounds the silhouettes of characters and objects on the GPU. Native Vulkan renderer only. Models from mods keep their own shape.
strings.ui.options.model_upscaling.needs_vulkan: Available with the Vulkan renderer only.
strings.ui.options.model_upscaling.no_tessellati: This GPU has no tessellation shaders.
strings.ui.options.model_upscaling.no_mesh_shade: This GPU has no mesh shaders, so only Tessellation is offered.
strings.ui.options.flashlight_lighting.help: The look of the flashlight beam and the light on Harry.
strings.ui.options.render_scale.help: Picture resolution against the window. Above 100% is sharper and slower.
strings.ui.options.shadow_filter.help: Softens the edges of the flashlight's shadows.
strings.ui.options.flashlight_intensity.help: How bright the modern flashlight is.
strings.ui.options.flashlight_size.help: How wide the modern flashlight's beam is.
strings.ui.options.quick_save_instant.help: Quick Save and Quick Load act at once, without a screen. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.resolution_aspect.help: Picks which resolutions the row below offers.
strings.ui.options.quick_save_instant.help_off: Off: the Quick Save key does not save. Turn on to save and load at once.
strings.ui.options.quick_save_keys.help: Quick Save / Quick Load. Press to change the keys and pad buttons.
strings.ui.options.language.locked: The language changes only in Options on the title screen.
strings.ui.options.persistent_remains.help: Dead enemies and their blood stay where they fell, for good. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.renderer.help: The graphics API the game draws with. Applies after a restart.
strings.ui.options.renderer.restart: The new renderer is used after a restart.
strings.ui.options.renderer.locked: Set by the -renderer command line argument for this run.
strings.ui.options.renderer.fallback: Vulkan could not start here, so the game runs on OpenGL.
strings.ui.options.restart.help: Restart the game to switch the renderer.
strings.ui.options.quick_setup.help: Language, renderer, graphics preset and display in four steps, with defaults detected for this PC. The game restarts.
strings.ui.options.quick_setup.confirm: Restart the game into the quick setup?
strings.ui.options.ray_tracing.help: Prepares the scene for the ray-traced effects below. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.ray_tracing.no_hardware: This GPU or its driver has no Vulkan ray tracing.
strings.ui.options.rt_shadows.help: Flashlight shadows by rays from the lens, denoised; replaces the shadow map. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.rt_reflections.help: Water, wet floors and polished tiles reflect what the light shows; never past the fog. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.rt_gi.help: The flashlight's light bounces once off what it hits; darkness stays as dark. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.rt_lights.help: Lamps, fires, the match and the daytime sun light the world with ray-traced shadows and highlights; the fog dims them. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.hdr_frame.help: Keeps light brighter than white, such as the flashlight's beam, for the tonemapper and bloom.
strings.ui.options.hdr_frame.no_float: Unavailable: this GPU has no float render targets.
strings.ui.options.hdr_tonemap.help: How light brighter than white returns to the screen. Clamp is the original look.
strings.ui.options.bloom.help: A faint glow around light brighter than white. The fog and the darkness stay as they are.
strings.ui.options.hdr_output.offscreen: Unavailable: there is no window to show HDR in.
strings.ui.options.hdr_output.no_extension: Unavailable: the Vulkan driver cannot output HDR.
strings.ui.options.hdr_output.no_display: Unavailable: the display or the system offers no HDR10 mode.
strings.ui.options.hdr_paper_white.help: How bright white is in menus and in the normal image.
strings.ui.options.hdr_peak.help: The brightest highlight sent to the display. Set it to your display's peak.
strings.ui.options.texture_upscale.help: Experimental. Sharper textures for the world, characters, items and 2D screens, made once by a neural network on the graphics card (Vulkan). More than x2 is not recommended: x4 tends to look smeared. Original: off.
strings.ui.options.texture_upscale.running: Upscaling in the background on the graphics card; each texture changes as soon as it is ready, those of the current place first.
strings.ui.options.texture_upscale.unavailable: The upscaler (sh-upscale) cannot start here, so the original textures stay.
strings.ui.options.graphics_preset.vulkan_only: This renderer cannot run the preset's Vulkan effects (HDR, TAA, lights, fog); they stay off.
strings.ui.options.graphics_preset.no_ray_tracin: Ray tracing needs the Vulkan renderer and a GPU that traces rays; it stays off here.
strings.ui.options.graphics_preset.upscaling: Textures are upscaled in the background; AI Texture Upscaling shows the progress.
strings.ui.options.graphics_preset.experimental: Experimental: adds AI texture upscaling (x2) and, on Vulkan, model upscaling.
